goal: 把新闻事件讲清楚并与朋友交流看法

n1.speaker: 同学 Ben
n1.line: Did you read the news about the severe floods hitting the southern provinces last week?
n1.lineCn: 你看到上周袭击南方各省的严重洪灾的新闻了吗?

grammar.name: 现在分词短语作后置定语
grammar.note: the floods hitting the southern provinces 中 hitting 短语修饰 floods,相当于定语从句 which hit。

options.text: I saw a report published yesterday. It says thousands of families have been evacuated.
options.textCn: 我看了昨天发布的一篇报道,说数千户家庭已被疏散。
options.feedback: 回应具体,讨论正式开始。

options.text: I rarely follow the news. I have no idea what is happening.
options.textCn: 我很少看新闻,完全不知道发生了什么。
options.feedback: 不关注时事,Ben 会引导你。

options.text: I read something about it, but the details I remember are quite vague.
options.textCn: 我读过一点,但记得的细节很模糊。
options.feedback: 记忆不清,Ben 帮你补全信息。

n2.speaker: 同学 Ben
n2.line: Exactly. The authorities have set up shelters accommodating nearly twenty thousand people.
n2.lineCn: 没错。当局已设立容纳近两万人的避难所。

grammar.name: 现在分词短语作定语
grammar.note: shelters accommodating nearly twenty thousand people 中 accommodating 修饰 shelters,信息更紧凑。

options.text: I also heard about the relief supplies sent by neighbouring cities. That is heart-warming.
options.textCn: 我也听说邻市送来的救援物资,真让人暖心。
options.feedback: 关注正面动态,讨论继续。

options.text: Relief supplies are not the point. The real issue is the warning system failing to alert villagers in time.
options.textCn: 物资不是重点,真正的问题是没能及时预警村民的报警系统。
options.feedback: 提出批评性观点,讨论深入。

options.text: I wish they had not closed the roads. Many people were trapped during the evacuation.
options.textCn: 真希望他们没封路。疏散时很多人被困住了。
options.feedback: 表达遗憾,讨论继续。

n3.speaker: 同学 Ben
n3.line: You should follow the news more closely. The lessons learned from past floods should never be forgotten.
n3.lineCn: 你应该更关注新闻。从过去洪灾中吸取的教训绝不能被遗忘。

grammar.name: 过去分词短语作后置定语
grammar.note: the lessons learned from past floods 中 learned 短语修饰 lessons,表被动与完成,相当于 which were learned。

options.text: You are right. I will read the full report issued by the government tonight.
options.textCn: 你说得对,我今晚就读政府发布的完整报告。
options.feedback: 愿意补课,讨论回到正题。

options.text: Even if I read it, what difference would it make to my life?
options.textCn: 就算我读了,对我的生活又有什么影响?
options.feedback: 态度冷漠,Ben 会继续劝导。

options.text: I will read it tonight, then we can discuss it together tomorrow.
options.textCn: 我今晚就读,明天我们再一起讨论。
options.feedback: 认真回应,气氛良好。

n4.speaker: 同学 Ben
n4.line: Indeed. The volunteers working around the clock deserve our respect and gratitude.
n4.lineCn: 的确。日夜奋战在洪灾一线的志愿者值得我们的尊敬与感激。

grammar.name: 现在分词短语作定语(进行)
grammar.note: working around the clock 作 volunteers 的后置定语,强调动作正在进行。

options.text: I agree. I am considering donating the money collected from our class fundraising.
options.textCn: 我同意。我正在考虑捐出班里募捐筹到的钱。
options.feedback: 行动积极,讨论推进。

options.text: Words are cheap. The question is whether the donations will actually reach those in need.
options.textCn: 说空话容易。问题是捐款能否真正到达需要的人手中。
options.feedback: 质疑落地效果,讨论更深入。

options.text: I would rather not talk about money. It makes me uncomfortable.
options.textCn: 我不想谈钱,这让我不自在。
options.feedback: 回避话题,Ben 会换个角度。

n4b.speaker: 同学 Ben
n4b.line: Great initiative. My class has launched a fundraising campaign running until the weekend.
n4b.lineCn: 好主意。我们班已经发起一场持续到周末的募捐活动。

grammar.name: 现在分词短语作定语(持续)
grammar.note: a fundraising campaign running until the weekend 中 running 修饰 campaign,说明活动期限。

options.text: I will contribute what I can, and I will persuade my roommates to join as well.
options.textCn: 我会尽力捐款,还会说服室友一起参加。
options.feedback: 带动他人参与,值得赞赏。

options.text: I am skeptical. The campaigns launched online are often full of fraud.
options.textCn: 我持怀疑态度。网上发起的活动常常骗局重重。
options.feedback: 提出疑虑,Ben 会给出回应。

options.text: I will donate, but only if my name is announced publicly.
options.textCn: 我可以捐,但前提是公开宣布我的名字。
options.feedback: 动机不纯,Ben 表示失望。

n5.speaker: 同学 Ben
n5.line: That is a fair criticism. The report published this morning admits that the early warning system has flaws.
n5.lineCn: 这个批评有道理。今早发布的报告承认预警系统存在缺陷。

grammar.name: 过去分词短语作定语
grammar.note: the report published this morning 中 published 修饰 report,表被动与完成。

options.text: Then the government should invest in better equipment before the next disaster arrives.
options.textCn: 那政府应该在下一场灾害来临前投资更好的设备。
options.feedback: 提出建设性意见,讨论深入。

options.text: I doubt anything will change. The promises made after each disaster are always the same.
options.textCn: 我怀疑什么都不会改变。每次灾后许下的承诺都一样。
options.feedback: 态度悲观,Ben 将疏导。

options.text: Perhaps we should focus on the victims rather than the system. The families affected need sympathy.
options.textCn: 也许我们该关注灾民而不是系统。受影响的家庭需要同情。
options.feedback: 视角温暖,讨论继续。

n6.speaker: 同学 Ben
n6.line: Well said. Let me share the key figures from the article I read: at least sixty schools damaged by the flood have been closed.
n6.lineCn: 说得好。让我分享我读的文章中的关键数字:至少六十所被洪水损毁的学校已经停课。

grammar.name: 过去分词短语作定语(受损)
grammar.note: sixty schools damaged by the flood 中 damaged 短语修饰 schools,被动且完成。

options.text: That is awful. The children forced to study at home will fall behind.
options.textCn: 太糟糕了。被迫在家学习的孩子们会落下功课。
options.feedback: 共情受害者,讨论继续。

options.text: Sixty schools is a large number, but the number of people rescued is also impressive.
options.textCn: 六十所学校很多,但获救的人数同样令人瞩目。
options.feedback: 从另一角度看待事件。

options.text: I feel too sad to keep discussing it. Let us change the subject.
options.textCn: 我太难过了,不想再讨论。换个话题吧。
options.feedback: 情绪回避,Ben 会引导。

n6b.speaker: 同学 Ben
n6b.line: And the government has promised to rebuild all the schools destroyed by the flood within a year.
n6b.lineCn: 而且政府承诺一年内重建所有被洪水摧毁的学校。

grammar.name: 过去分词短语作定语(重建)
grammar.note: all the schools destroyed by the flood 中 destroyed 修饰 schools,补充完整信息。

options.text: That is encouraging. A promise followed by action is worth believing.
options.textCn: 令人鼓舞。用行动兑现的承诺才值得相信。
options.feedback: 态度积极,讨论升温。

options.text: A year is too long. The children waiting in temporary classrooms need faster help.
options.textCn: 一年太久了。在临时教室等待的孩子们需要更快的帮助。
options.feedback: 提出不同意见,观点碰撞。

options.text: Rebuilding is easy; the trust lost during the disaster is harder to restore.
options.textCn: 重建容易,灾难中失去的信任更难修复。
options.feedback: 观点深刻,Ben 表示赞同。

n7.speaker: 同学 Ben
n7.line: Avoiding bad news will not make it disappear. There is a lesson to be learned behind every headline.
n7.lineCn: 回避坏消息不会让它消失。每条头条背后都有值得学习的教训。

grammar.name: 不定式作定语(被动)
grammar.note: a lesson to be learned 中不定式被动式作 lesson 的定语,表有待发生的事情。

options.text: I suppose you are right. What is the lesson you take from this event?
options.textCn: 我想你是对的。你从这个事件中学到的教训是什么?
options.feedback: 回归讨论,请教观点。

options.text: My lesson is simple: never trust the numbers reported by the media.
options.textCn: 我的教训很简单:永远不要相信媒体报道的数字。
options.feedback: 观点偏激,Ben 会回应。

options.text: I still prefer happy news. Pass me the sports section instead.
options.textCn: 我还是喜欢看开心的新闻。把体育版给我吧。
options.feedback: 彻底回避,Ben 无奈。

n8.speaker: 同学 Ben
n8.line: For me, the most valuable message to remember is that we are never truly prepared for nature.
n8.lineCn: 对我来说,最值得记住的启示是:我们对大自然永远谈不上真正准备充分。

grammar.name: 不定式作定语(记忆)
grammar.note: the most valuable message to remember 中不定式 to remember 修饰 message。

options.text: Beautifully said. I will share the report with my family so that they stay alert as well.
options.textCn: 说得太美了。我会把报道分享给家人,让他们也保持警惕。
options.feedback: 主动传播信息,交流愉快。

options.text: I agree with you, yet I wonder whether the media exaggerates the tragedy to attract viewers.
options.textCn: 我同意你,但我也怀疑媒体是否夸大悲剧来吸引观众。
options.feedback: 保留批判性思考,交流继续。

options.text: This is all too depressing. I wish I had never read the news.
options.textCn: 这一切太压抑了。我真希望从没看过新闻。
options.feedback: 消极退缩,Ben 失望。

n9.speaker: 同学 Ben
n9.line: I am glad we had this conversation. A citizen informed about world affairs is a citizen who can act wisely.
n9.lineCn: 很高兴我们聊了这些。一个了解天下事的公民,才能明智地行动。

grammar.name: 过去分词作定语(了解)
grammar.note: a citizen informed about world affairs 中 informed about 短语修饰 citizen,含义接近 well-informed。

options.text: I could not agree more. Let us follow the follow-up reports together next week.
options.textCn: 我再同意不过了。下周我们一起跟踪后续报道吧。
options.feedback: 达成共识,讨论圆满结束。

options.text: Acting wisely is your concern, not mine. I will stick to my own little world.
options.textCn: 明智行动是你的事,不是我的。我守着自己的小世界就好。
options.feedback: 拒绝担当公民责任,Ben 遗憾。

options.text: I will follow the reports, though I refuse to be saddened by every tragedy.
options.textCn: 我会跟进报道,只是拒绝为每场悲剧悲伤。
options.feedback: 保持理性参与,讨论收尾。

success.speaker: 同学 Ben
success.line: Deal! Knowledge is our shared responsibility. See you next week with the latest reports.
success.lineCn: 一言为定!了解真相是我们共同的责任。下周带着最新报道见。

fail1.speaker: 同学 Ben
fail1.line: I am sorry you feel that way. Ignoring reality will not make the world safer for any of us.
fail1.lineCn: 你这样想我很遗憾。无视现实不会让世界对我们任何人更安全。

fail2.speaker: 同学 Ben
fail2.line: If you shut your eyes to the world, the world will one day knock at your door unannounced.
fail2.lineCn: 如果你对世界闭上眼睛,世界总有一天会不请自来地敲你的门。
